source.title: Development of Optically-Controlled “Living Electrodes” with Long-Projecting Axon Tracts for a Synaptic Brain-Machine Interface

material: Agarose microcolumn (3% w/v) with collagen-laminin ECM lumen seeded with cortical neuron aggregates (µTENN), in vitro

formulation.evidence: 1.0 mg/ml rat tail collagen + 1.0 mg/ml mouse laminin
1.0 mg/ml rat tail collagen + 1.0 mg/ml mouse laminin

processing.evidence: resulting in microcolumns with a 398 µm OD and a 180 µm ID
resulting in microcolumns with a 398 µm OD and a 180 µm ID
Microcolumns were sterilized via UV light for 30 min
centrifuged in the wells at 200g for 5 min

culture_days.evidence: Neuronal survival in µTENNs was observed to persist up to at least 28 DIV, with further demonstration of survival out to 40 DIV

viability_percent.evidence: planar culture viability at 10 DIV surpassed those of both LEUNI (68.1%) and LEBI (69.0%) at 28 DIV

other_outcomes.evidence: All aggregate µTENNs exhibited rapid axonal growth rates, peaking at 1101.8±81.1 microns/day within the LEBI,9 group.
other_outcomes.name: peak axonal growth rate (LEBI,9)

other_outcomes.evidence: LEUNI,2, with an average maximum growth rate of 580±43.9 microns/day at 1 DIV
other_outcomes.name: average maximum axonal growth rate (LEUNI,2)

other_outcomes.evidence: dissociated µTENNs exhibited a peak growth rate of 61.7±5 microns/day at 1 DIV
other_outcomes.name: peak axonal growth rate (dissociated µTENNs)

other_outcomes.evidence: LEUNI and LEBI showed a 15.2% and 18.6% drop over time, respectively
other_outcomes.name: viability drop from 10 to 28 DIV (LEUNI / LEBI)

survival.evidence: statistically lower than that of LEUNI (80.3%) (p < 0.05), LEBI (84.8%) (p < 0.001), and planar cultures (97.7%) (p < 0.0001) at 10 DIV.
